_comment: Floyd's settings that used to be compiled into src/ as defaults, or lived only as example values in .env.example.
Read by scripts/seed-hub-settings.ts and by nothing else. An environment variable that is set wins over a value here, so seeding from production's environment writes production's values.
news_sync: Floyd's news sync has always been the Wix blog feed of floydcova.gov. Until 2026-09-24 that URL was the code default.
meeting_summary: Floyd's production configuration, which .env.example carried as its worked example until 2026-09-24. The connector ladder's defaults are empty; these are Floyd's.
legal: who is answerable for Floyd's hub and where to reach them. No env var ever held these; until 2026-09-24 they were literals in scripts/seed-hub-settings.ts.

identity/copy: Floyd's banner and governing body, as on the dev project. Production sets them from VITE_HUB_* env vars, which win when set; these are what a fresh database (CI, a new local stack) gets.
identity/copy/wordcloud (2026-09-24): Floyd's branding copy, moved from the committed ui/.env, where Vite compiled it into every hub's build.
identity.banner_alt: Downtown Floyd, Virginia — the Floyd Civic Hub

copy.intro_body: This is where Floyd County residents keep up with county government, raise topics that matter, help make sense of issues together, and have conversations to see where our community stands.
